text: Noongar koorl yamatji moorditj wirn kepal-ak.
english_translation: Noongar went to a person with a strong illness at the river.
Wandjukat said at the ocean there is a meeting about pain.

text: Nidja keny Noongar djinang moorditj ngarrik.
english_translation: This one Noongar saw a strong fever being treated.
